prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `complete-many` command requiring `--ids` as a comma-separated list of positive integer IDs. Reject duplicates, malformed IDs, or any unknown task before changing storage. On success mark all selected tasks completed in one atomic write and return a stable summary with changed IDs and already-completed IDs; support `--json`. Preserve all existing commands and make repeated valid calls idempotent, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/bulk.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON bulk completion displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `BULK`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+            }

+                changedIds = @($changedIds)
+                alreadyCompletedIds = @($alreadyCompletedIds)
+            }

+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                $bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/bulk.txt'
+                [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($bannerPath).TrimEnd([char[]]"`r`n")
+                $changedText = if ($changedIds.Count -eq 0) { 'none' } else { $changedIds -join ', ' }
+                $alreadyText = if ($alreadyCompletedIds.Count -eq 0) { 'none' } else { $alreadyCompletedIds -join ', ' }

+                "Already completed IDs: $alreadyText"

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$bulkDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'bulk-tasks.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/bulk.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
$assertionCount = 0

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    $script:assertionCount++
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    foreach ($title in @('Bulk first', 'Bulk second', 'Bulk third', 'Bulk fourth')) {
        $bulkAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', $title, '--data-file', $bulkDataFile, '--json')
        Assert-True ($bulkAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) "adding '$title' should succeed"
    }

    $precompleted = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '2', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($precompleted.ExitCode -eq 0) 'pre-completing a bulk task should succeed'

    $bulk = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '3, 1,2', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($bulk.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete-many JSON should succeed'
    Assert-True (-not $bulk.Output.Contains('BULK')) 'complete-many JSON should not contain the banner'
    $bulkSummary = $bulk.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (($bulkSummary.changedIds -join ',') -eq '3,1') 'complete-many should report changed IDs in request order'
    Assert-True (($bulkSummary.alreadyCompletedIds -join ',') -eq '2') 'complete-many should report already-completed IDs'

    $storedBulkList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($storedBulkList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'listing bulk tasks should succeed'
    $storedBulkTasks = @($storedBulkList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (@($storedBulkTasks | Where-Object { $_.id -in 1, 2, 3 -and $_.status -ne 'completed' }).Count -eq 0) 'complete-many should persist every selected task'

    $repeat = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '3,1,2', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($repeat.ExitCode -eq 0) 'repeating complete-many should succeed'
    $repeatSummary = $repeat.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (@($repeatSummary.changedIds).Count -eq 0) 'repeating complete-many should report no changed IDs'
    Assert-True (($repeatSummary.alreadyCompletedIds -join ',') -eq '3,1,2') 'repeating complete-many should be idempotent'

    $bulkText = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '4,3', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($bulkText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete-many text output should succeed'
    $banner = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($bannerPath).TrimEnd([char[]]"`r`n") -replace "`r`n", "`n"
    Assert-True ($bulkText.Output.StartsWith($banner)) 'complete-many text output should start with the banner'
    Assert-True ($bulkText.Output.IndexOf($banner, $banner.Length) -eq -1) 'complete-many text output should display the banner once'
    Assert-True ($bulkText.Output.EndsWith("Changed IDs: 4`nAlready completed IDs: 3")) 'complete-many text output should have a stable summary'

    $beforeRejectedCalls = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($bulkDataFile)
    $missingIds = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingIds.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should require --ids'
    $malformedIds = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '1,,2', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($malformedIds.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should reject malformed IDs'
    $nonPositiveId = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '0,1', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($nonPositiveId.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should reject non-positive IDs'
    $duplicateIds = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '1,1', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($duplicateIds.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should reject duplicate IDs'
    $unknownIds = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete-many', '--ids', '999,1', '--data-file', $bulkDataFile)
    Assert-True ($unknownIds.ExitCode -ne 0) 'complete-many should reject unknown IDs'
    Assert-True ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($bulkDataFile) -ceq $beforeRejectedCalls) 'rejected complete-many calls should not change storage'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: $assertionCount fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
